how: Calls recruit help for a giant carrot, idle tiles for new work, and placements to complete a blue carrot.

The farm argues colours, adds themed carrots, protects an orange original, and proposes consolidating old carrots into one large carrot.

Only operative references and instructions support template coordination, since an HQ drawing or tribute alone does not show that placers used it.

Polls and explicit consensus procedures place this room among cases with decided order rather than contradicting the model's cross-room majority claim.
Design decisions move into chat and return as public announcements, connecting venue choice to the design ultimately retained.
Background selection depends on preserving an alliance when protection is invoked against an initially preferred colour.

After a losing defense, members propose rebuilding over the old farm and an original builder announces a fresh carrot.
A truce permits a contested letter and exchanges restoration of the preferred name for referral and maintenance promises under manpower pressure.
